meta.title: Where to Stay in Da Nang (Best Areas + What to Avoid!)
meta.description:
Full area guide: https://timelesstravelchapters.com/da-nang-where-to-stay/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=da-nang-where-to-stay

Not sure where to stay in Da Nang? 🏖️ Choosing the right area can make or break your trip. In this guide, we’ll cover the best areas to stay in Da Nang — plus a few places first-timers might want to avoid.

✨ In this video:
0:00 Intro
0:30 My Khe Beach – Best for First-Time Visitors
1:40 City Center & Han River – Best for Convenience
2:50 Son Tra Peninsula – Best for Nature & Views
3:50 Near Hoi An – Best for a Relaxed Experience
4:50 Areas to Avoid in Da Nang
6:20 Wrap Up

💡 Highlights:

My Khe Beach 🏝️ – classic beachfront with restaurants and cafes
Han River area 🌉 – bridges, rooftop bars, and nightlife
Son Tra Peninsula 🌿 – stunning views and peaceful resorts
Between Da Nang & Hoi An 🛕 – a quieter base for both cities
What to Avoid ⚠️ – inland hotels, industrial port, remote resorts, and more

Whether you’re looking for Da Nang hotels, family-friendly resorts, or budget areas, this video will help you decide where to stay in Da Nang for your 2025 trip.

Don’t forget to like 👍, subscribe 🔔, and check out our other Da Nang guides for things to do, nightlife, and food in Vietnam!

You can view our full Da Nang video playlist here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL6KVe3y9MSLPYe7FL5DF3d5tvOcpNReGo
